subject: ACME POC — post-demo disruption and proposed makegood
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeiot.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Bennett <sara@acmeiot.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo — service disruption during our walkthrough

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for jumping on the call earlier. To recap: during our scheduled POC walkthrough at ~08:40 PT your hosted endpoint returned 503s and then very high latency for about 14 minutes. The demo failed and our internal stakeholders were pretty upset — this was the final sign-off meeting before procurement.

Can you confirm what happened and whether Redwood will consider a compensation gesture? We aren't asking for a refund yet, but something to show good faith/cover the lost demo window would go a long way while we decide next steps.

I can share logs if that helps.

— Liam
Product Lead, Acme IoT Solutions

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeiot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sara Bennett <sara@acmeiot.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — service disruption during our walkthrough

Hi Liam —

I am really sorry about the disruption during your sign-off demo. That's on us and I completely understand the urgency. Thank you for the clear timeline.

Immediate next steps:
- I've looped in our support/engineering lead (David Kim) to collect logs and confirm the root cause.
- Sales-side, Marissa and I will put together a make-good offer you can present to your stakeholders by EOD tomorrow.

Preliminarily, we usually offer a token top-up + trial extension for POC-impact cases. If you can share the requestor list, we can also fast-track a one-month dedicated onboarding review.

Would you be able to send the logs (or permission to pull them)? If you prefer, David can take a secure upload link.

Again — apologies. We want to make this right.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeiot.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — service disruption during our walkthrough

Hi Liam / Rafael —

Thanks for the ping. Rafael, I pulled the request traces for the 08:30–08:50PT window and attached a trimmed incident log for your review (incident_log.zip).

Preliminary findings:
- A short-lived routing flap in us-west-2 caused a minority of requests to land on a degraded worker pool while autoscaling reacted; this produced 503s and increased p95 token latency until the fallback completed.
- No customer data leakage identified; KV cache rehydration and batching backpressure amplified tail latency.

Next steps I recommend:
1) We will schedule a 30m postmortem review with your engineers to go over the trace and mitigation steps.
2) Our infra team will pin a stable routing policy for your workspace to prevent similar routing-induced flaps during your remaining POC.

Attachment: incident_log.zip (trace excerpts, 82KB)

Happy to set the postmortem. Rafael / Marissa, flag if you want a public-friendly summary for Acme's procurement committee.

— David
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeiot.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed make-good: ACME POC disruption (internal approval requested)

Hi team —

Following up with a concrete make-good proposal for Acme after the demo disruption. I recommend we offer the following to help preserve the deal momentum:

- 100,000 complimentary generation tokens (applied to Acme's workspace immediately).
- 60-day trial extension on enterprise trial window (no additional cost).
- One complimentary 2-hr priority onboarding session with our solutions engineering team (value: $6,000).

Notes for approval:
- This is slightly above our standard token top-up for POC failures; Rafael, I'm asking Hannah to bless given the deal size and the lost sign-off meeting.
- I will prepare a customer-facing PDF and a HubSpot note once we have approval.

Hannah — can you confirm internal approval? I can pivot the numbers if you want a lower comp package.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeiot.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed make-good: ACME POC disruption (internal approval requested)

Marissa / Rafael / David —

Thank you for the context and David for the incident summary. I approve the make-good, with one modification: upgrade the token amount to 150,000 and extend the priority onboarding to include one month of dedicated technical office hours (to ensure Acme recovers any lost momentum).

Please proceed with customer comms and attach the formal offer PDF (acme-healing-offer-20261030.pdf). Rafael — send the HubSpot update and the DocuSign link for Acme to sign the simple T&Cs that reflect the token credit and onboarding schedule.

Once sent, flag me if Acme asks for further concessions; we'll escalate as needed.

Approved: Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
